VVhich they hearing, {{ls}}aid to him, God forbid. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=17}} But he beholding them {{ls}}aid, VVhat is this then that is vvritten, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''P{{ls}}. 117, 22.''}}* ''The {{ls}}tone vvhich the builders reiected, the {{ls}}ame is become into the head of the corner''? {{verse|chapter=20|verse=18}} Euery one that falleth vpon this {{ls}}tone, {{ls}}hal be qua{{ls}}hed: and vpon vvhom it {{ls}}hal fall, it {{ls}}hal breake him to pouder. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=19}} And the cheefe Prie{{ls}}ts and Scribes {{ls}}ought to lay handes vpon him that houre: and they feared the people. for they knevv that he {{ls}}pake this {{ls}}imilitude to them.<noinclude>{{rh|||And}}</noinclude>
